Vera Filipovic  
Munich, Germany | v.filipovic@email.com | +49 176 123 4567 | linkedin.com/in/verafilipovic  

Professional Experience  
At SafeNet Innovations, I lead security architecture for their SaaS platform, focusing on secure API gateways and identity management systems. My work reduced unauthorized access attempts by 35% through enhanced IAM protocols and integration of multi-factor authentication. I also spearheaded encryption upgrades to AES-256, which lowered data breach risks by 40% in production environments. Previously, at CyberShield Solutions, I designed network security policies that cut vulnerability exposure by 25% during quarterly audits. My role there involved regular penetration testing, identifying critical misconfigurations that could have led to 12+ potential breaches.  

Education  
BSc in Cybersecurity, University of Oregon, 2020. Thesis: “Securing Cloud-Native Applications: A Case Study on OWASP Top Ten Mitigations.” Graduated with distinction, emphasizing hands-on experience with secure coding practices and threat modeling.  

Projects / Side Projects  
Developed a custom IAM framework for a fintech startup, integrating OAuth 2.0 and role-based access controls to streamline user permissions while reducing privilege escalation risks by 20%. Led a project to automate vulnerability scans using Qualys, resulting in a 50% faster remediation cycle for critical vulnerabilities. Designed a secure API gateway for a healthcare client, applying OWASP guidelines to block 98% of injection attacks during beta testing. Contributed to an open-source project enhancing TLS protocol compliance in legacy systems, which was adopted by three regional service providers.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
Firewall configuration: Implemented Cisco ASA rulesets to block 80% of brute-force login attempts across SafeNet’s distributed infrastructure. Network security: Conducted regular audits to ensure compliance with ISO 27001 standards, maintaining a 95% uptime for secure communication channels. Penetration testing: Identified and patched 15+ critical vulnerabilities in CyberShield’s customer portal, preventing potential financial losses exceeding €200K. Security auditing: Streamlined audit workflows by 30% through centralized log analysis, improving incident response times by 25%.  

Application security (OWASP): Owned the redesign of SafeNet’s web application firewall, reducing OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities by 60% in six months. Encryption & PKI: Spearheaded the migration to Elliptic Curve Cryptography, enhancing data protection for 500,000+ users without service disruptions. IAM/Access control: Built a zero-trust model for CyberShield’s internal tools, cutting lateral movement risks by 70% during red-team exercises. Vulnerability management: Established a continuous integration pipeline for security scans, reducing high-severity issues by 45% in production environments.  

Certifications  
CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) | 2022  
OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional) | 2021  
CompTIA Security+ | 2019  

Awards & Achievements  
Received the “Innovator in Cybersecurity” award at SafeNet’s 2023 annual review for pioneering secure microservices architecture. Recognized by CyberShield for contributing to a 30% reduction in security incident resolution time through proactive threat intelligence integration.
